notes.src/core/analytics/events/elevar-legacy-: `formatElevarProduct` computes `const currency = getCurrency()` and drops the result (`ElevarProduct` has no currency field) — but `getCurrency()` reads the campaign store and can `logger.warn` on failure, and `formatElevarProduct` itself is still called on every legacy-format event. Deleting the local would delete that warn path too, which is a behavior change, not a dead-code fix. Reported as finding 163's 'found alongside' note in docs/code-findings.md.
notes.src/core/analytics/tracking/auto-event-c: `handleOrderCompleted` builds a complete, correct `purchaseData` from `order.lines` and never reads it — the event that actually ships is built from the pre-order cart snapshot instead. This is finding 163 in docs/code-findings.md: the discarded value is the *correct* one, so deleting it would remove the fix rather than dead code. Which source should back the purchase event is a product decision, not this gate's call.
notes.src/core/debug/debug-overlay/debug-overl: `updateMiniCart` is a real, live method — `src/core/debug/tests/debug-overlay.test.ts` calls it via `(overlay.updateMiniCart as () => void).call(overlay)` on an instance typed as `Record<string, unknown>`. That cast means the checker never sees the call as a reference to the class member, so `noUnusedLocals` reports a private method that a test genuinely exercises. Gate blind spot, not dead code.
notes.src/features/cart/package-selector/packa: `updateCart(previous, selected, items)`'s `previous` parameter is never read in the body, yet every call site constructs a real, non-null value for it when a swap is happening (`package-selector.cards.ts` builds `{ ...item, packageId: oldId }` specifically to pass as `previous`) and the colocated tests pass real values without ever asserting on them. That shape — callers going out of their way to supply a value the callee ignores — reads as a possible latent bug in the swap logic, not a parameter that only exists for an interface. Left alone and reported rather than silently prefixed with `_`.
notes.src/features/checkout/checkout-form/chec: Out of scope for this change — `features/checkout/checkout-form/**` is owned by another agent working in parallel (per this task's file ownership split), and was mid-refactor (splitting into country-selection.ts/field-scanning.ts/form-population.ts/location-field-visibility.ts) at the moment this baseline was captured, which is why the count here (16 at last capture) will not match a fresh `check:unused` run once that work lands — re-ratchet with `npm run check:unused:update` once the split is done rather than treating a mismatch here as this gate misbehaving.
notes.src/features/checkout/prospect-cart/pros: `collectUtmData()` and `getCurrency()` are private wrapper methods around the same-named functions imported from `./cart-creation` — never called from the enhancer's own source, but both are called directly in tests via `(enhancer as any).collectUtmData()` / `(enhancer as any).getCurrency()` (see `tests/prospect-cart.enhancer.test.ts`). Same `as any`-cast blind spot as the debug-overlay entry above: live per the tests, invisible to the checker.
